decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch line sits close to the core seasonal offer and was featured on the home page in both years, so management sees it as part of its established direction and keeps it.
This one-tier pyramid is a core-type product with prominent placement, and craft pyramids hold long shelf lives in Erzgebirge-style assortments, so it stays.
The firm presented the electronic music box line as a flagship of its direction and has invested visibly in several models, so escalation of commitment strongly favours persisting.
The firm extended this motif platform with a second edition and gave it its own page, which ties it to the flagship music box line and signals continued commitment despite its distance from the core.
This seasonal Christmas motif for the flagship music box gets only minor mentions and could be swapped out, but it supports the publicly committed music box direction, so it is kept for now.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on the firm's traditional strengths, was shown on the home page, and fits typical long-running collectible assortments, so it is kept.
